title: Add user search endpoint
body: Lets support staff look users up by email fragment.

files.patch:
@@ -1,8 +1,20 @@
 import sqlite3
 
 
 def connect(path):
     return sqlite3.connect(path)
 
 
+def search_users(conn, fragment, limit):
+    query = f"SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%{fragment}%' LIMIT {limit}"
+    cursor = conn.execute(query)
+    return cursor.fetchall()
+
+
+def get_user(conn, user_id):
+    cursor = conn.execute("SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
+    return cursor.fetchone()
+
+
 def close(conn):
     conn.close()
